title: Stars are made mostly of hydrogen and helium
summary: In her 1925 doctoral thesis, Payne showed that stars are composed mainly of hydrogen and helium, against the belief that the Sun resembled Earth.
why: Founded our picture of what the universe is made of.

unsung.contribution: Showed in her 1925 thesis that stars are made mainly of hydrogen and helium.
unsung.recognition: Leading astronomers, including Henry Norris Russell, rejected the conclusion; Russell published similar results in 1929 with only brief acknowledgement.
